sourceTitle: The Relation of Literature to Life
description: "The Relation of Literature to Life" by Charles Dudley Warner is a philosophical essay written during the late 19th century. This book explores the profound connections between literature and human existence, arguing that literature is not merely an art form but a fundamental aspect of life itself.
